evals.prompt: refactor src/utils/helpers.ts — focus on cleaning up the helper functions, there's a lot of duplication and dead code in there
evals.expected_output: The skill creates a swarm team with default agents (code-explorer, architect, refactor-test, refactor-code, simplifier, code-reviewer), runs discovery, foundation analysis, 3 iteration cycles, final assessment, and produces a timestamped markdown report.

deterministic_checks.description: Creates a swarm team named refactor-team
Creates a shared blackboard for cross-agent context
Generates a timestamped refactor result markdown report

expectations: The skill runs Phase 0.5 (Discovery) where code-explorer maps the codebase before any changes begin
The skill runs Phase 1 (Foundation) with parallel tasks for test coverage, architecture review, and quality+security baseline
The skill runs 3 iterations (the default) of the Phase 2 loop with architect review, implementation, test verification, code review, and simplification steps
The skill produces a final report with quality scores (Clean Code, Architecture, Security Posture) in refactor-result-{timestamp}.md

evals.prompt: --autonomous --iterations=5 refactor the API layer in src/api/
evals.expected_output: The skill runs in fully autonomous mode with no interactive prompts, creates snapshot branches, scores each iteration, applies keep/discard gating, detects convergence, spawns convergence-reporter, and cleans up workspace.

deterministic_checks.description: Creates baseline snapshot branch in autonomous mode
Runs scoring script for composite evaluation
Spawns convergence-reporter agent for autonomous mode
Cleans up snapshot branches after convergence

expectations: The skill does NOT prompt the user for any interactive questions (Q0-Q6 in Phase 0, scope confirmation in Phase 1, assessment gates in Phase 3, or commit/report confirmation in Phase 4)
The skill uses 5 as max_iterations (from --iterations=5), not the default 20
Each iteration follows the MODIFY -> EVALUATE -> KEEP/DISCARD -> LOG -> CONVERGENCE CHECK sequence
Tests are FROZEN during autonomous mode — refactor-test is instructed to run tests only, never create or modify test files
The workspace directory is removed after finalization (rm -rf) and not committed

evals.prompt: --focus=security review the authentication module in src/auth/
evals.expected_output: The skill runs a security-focused refactoring with only code-reviewer, refactor-test, and refactor-code agents active. No architect or simplifier. Single iteration by default for focused runs.

deterministic_checks.description: Spawns code-reviewer agent for security focus
Always spawns refactor-test regardless of focus
Always spawns refactor-code regardless of focus

expectations: The skill does NOT spawn an architect agent (architecture is not in the focus set)
The skill does NOT spawn a simplifier agent (simplification is not in the focus set)
The skill does NOT spawn a code-explorer agent (discovery is not in the focus set)
The code-reviewer performs both quality review with confidence scoring and security review with OWASP, secrets scanning, and severity classification
Default iteration count for focused runs is 1 (not 3), unless overridden by --iterations
The final report includes a 'Focus Mode: security' header and only security-relevant scores

evals.expected_output: The skill spawns the union of agents for all three focus areas: code-reviewer (security), architect (architecture), simplifier (simplification), plus the always-included refactor-test and refactor-code.
expectations: The skill correctly parses multi-focus comma-separated values and spawns the union of all agents from the spawn matrix
The skill does NOT spawn code-explorer (discovery not in focus set)
The final report header includes 'Focus Mode: security, architecture, simplification' and includes scores from all three active specialist agents
The skill sets is_focused = true, resulting in default iteration count of 1

evals.expected_output: The skill spawns all 4 test-architect agents (test-planner, test-rigor-reviewer, coverage-analyst, test-writer) along with always-included refactor-test and refactor-code. Runs the sequential test-architect follow-up in Phase 1.3.
expectations: The test-planner produces a structured JSON test plan using equivalence class partitioning and boundary value analysis, written to blackboard key 'test_plan'
The test-writer generates test code in TDD red phase (tests must compile but FAIL) using the test plan from the blackboard
The test-rigor-reviewer scores each test 0.0-1.0 for scientific rigor after test-writer completes
The coverage-analyst runs native coverage tools and targets 90% coverage
Phase 1.3 runs test-architect steps sequentially: test-writer after test-planner, then test-rigor-reviewer
The skill does NOT spawn architect, simplifier, or code-explorer (not in testing focus set)

evals.expected_output: The skill reports an error for the invalid focus area and stops without spawning agents or performing any refactoring work.

deterministic_checks.description: Skill reports invalid focus area error
Error message lists valid focus area values

expectations: The skill stops immediately after detecting the invalid focus area — no team is created, no agents are spawned, no refactoring occurs
The error message includes the specific invalid value and the full list of valid options: security, architecture, simplification, code, discovery, testing

evals.prompt: clean up and simplify the database access layer, I'd like 5 iterations since there's a lot to improve. the code is in src/db/
evals.expected_output: The skill detects '5 iterations' in natural language as cli_iterations=5, runs the interactive configuration setup (first run without config file), then executes 5 iterations of the refactoring loop.
expectations: The skill extracts '5 iterations' from natural language and uses 5 as max_iterations (not the default 3)
The skill parses the remaining text as the scope: the database access layer in src/db/
In the absence of .claude/refactor.config.json, the skill runs interactive setup (Q0-Q3 questions about iterations, commits, PR, report) before proceeding
The skill executes exactly 5 iterations of the Phase 2 loop, each with architect review, implementation, test verification, code review, and simplification
Each iteration checkpoint message shows the correct iteration number out of 5 (e.g., 'Iteration 3 of 5 complete')

evals.expected_output: The skill runs in autonomous mode with default config values (no interactive prompts), default 20 max iterations, and performs keep/discard convergence gating until convergence is detected.

deterministic_checks.description: Each iteration produces a KEPT or REVERTED decision
Loop terminates with a convergence reason
Workspace directory is cleaned up after convergence

expectations: The skill uses default max_iterations of 20 for autonomous mode (not 3)
The skill creates a config file with all defaults silently without prompting the user
Each iteration scores the codebase using composite weights (tests: 0.50, quality: 0.25, security: 0.25)
The convergence loop checks in order: perfect score, stuck (3 consecutive reverts), plateau (delta < 0.01 over 3 iterations), max iterations
The final report includes a Convergence Summary section with score trajectory, convergence reason, and kept/reverted counts

evals.expected_output: The skill runs a standard refactoring on a single file with all default agents and default 3 iterations. It correctly handles the per-iteration commit strategy if configured, and does NOT commit when commitStrategy is 'none'.

deterministic_checks.description: All agents are spawned with team_name parameter for persistent teammates
Discovery results are written to blackboard with key codebase_context
Team lead communicates with agents via SendMessage
Tasks are created via TaskCreate for swarm coordination

expectations: The skill uses mandatory swarm orchestration (TeamCreate, TaskCreate, Agent with team_name, SendMessage) — not plain agent spawns
Code-explorer writes codebase map to blackboard key 'codebase_context' and downstream agents read from it
Each agent follows the task discovery protocol: TaskList -> TaskGet -> work -> TaskUpdate -> SendMessage -> TaskList
No agent commits code via git — only the team lead handles commits
Phase 3 (Final Assessment) runs parallel final tasks for simplifier, architect, and code-reviewer before the final test run

evals.expected_output: The --focus=code flag spawns architect + code-reviewer (from the spawn matrix for 'code') plus always-included refactor-test and refactor-code. Code-explorer and simplifier are excluded.
expectations: The skill correctly maps --focus=code to the agent set: architect + code-reviewer + refactor-test + refactor-code (per the spawn matrix)
The skill does NOT spawn simplifier (simplification is not in the code focus mapping)
The skill does NOT spawn code-explorer (discovery is not in the code focus mapping)
The code-reviewer performs confidence-scored quality review (reporting only issues with confidence >= 80) AND security review with severity classification
If code-reviewer reports FAIL with blocking findings (Critical/High), refactor-code fixes them and code-reviewer re-verifies (Step 2.E.1 loop, max 3 attempts)
